scope: Prime-order ordinary CM curves under the stated maximal-order and unit assumptions; exact finite control p=47,r=61
statement: For maximal imaginary-quadratic CM with n=(pi-1) of prime norm r and units {+-1}, the ray class group maps onto the ordinary class group with kernel F_r^*/{+-1}; a principal relation alpha=a+b*pi has known kernel residue a+b mod r and acts by that known scalar on E(F_p). On the p=47, r=61, D=-19 control, 1+pi has norm 35 and residue 2.
